Art Club.name: Art Club
Art Club.description:
🎨 You carried a sketchbook in every bag and spent your afternoons in the art club.

🖼️ You made the posters for every school event.
🎯 Good for designing your own hero costume.

📈 Grants: Visual Arts +5, Costume Design +5
Art Club.traitNarrativeEffects: The character drew and designed through high school: sketches, posters, costumes for the school play. They notice color, shape and detail, and they remember faces and outfits.
